Hold a Public, legally binding Referendum on the future of the NHS., Hold a referendum on the future of the NHS with 2 voting options.
1. Carry on with government plans.
2. Maintain 100% national ownership

Set a time limit for decisions on EUSS applications., EUSS is Discriminatory on EU Family without Application Decision Time Limit.

UK government should give a time limit on the application process for EUSS / EUSS Family Permit.
Stop face masks in secondary schools., Stop schools from forcing children under 18 from wearing masks for long periods of the school day.

Amend The Children's Act 1989 to include relationships with grandparents, in 2018 Justice Minister publicly said she consider if the need for a change in the law in relation to grandparents, stating the need for reforms clear that the system could work better. Nothing has progressed, help children maintain their right too safe, loving relationships with grandparents.

Include British Sign Language in the primary school curriculum, I would like the government to incorporate British Sign Language into the standard school curriculum. To provide funding for teachers to learn BSL and for schools to provide resources for students. At a minimum, poster boards with basic BSL on classroom walls to help include all students.

Change social housing rules for those needing a 4 bedroom to include 3 bedrooms, Social housing tenants who qualify for a 4 bedroom property are currently only allowed to bid on 4 bedrooms, lots of these families are in 1 or 2 bedrooms and grossly overcrowded. It should be that they can bid on 3 bedrooms to alleviate their situation until a suitable home is available

Make the Ministerial code legally binding to ensure accountability and ethics., By making the Ministerial code and seven principles of public life legally binding will  ensure sound professional conduct confidence in our leaders.
Ltns Oxfordshire, reconsider the LTns in oxford as we all feel trapped and the council dose not listen to us and people are dieing because of it help us

Stop private parking  organisations and companies stealing from the public, Put a stop to busineses that are private car parking enforcement and to stop the theft of public peoples monies and the unfair harassment to people and citizens

Stop all schools detaining children after school in the winter months, For all schools to be banned from detaining pupils after school in the winter months and sending them home in the dark with no regard for their safety

Fund increased support for children with additional needs in mainstream schools, We need more support in mainstream schools for children with additional needs. This is important for when child are waiting for an EHCP or space at an SEN school, which can take a long time, when the child may not getting the support they need educationally or developmentally.

Do not require Attorney General consent for international law prosecutions , In international crimes Parliament legislated that the consent of the Attorney General is required before a criminal prosecution may be initiated. This breaches principles of natural justice; separation of power and denies Victims justice in indicting members of HM Government for inter. crimes.

Ban plastic bags in the UK, Single use plastic bags are problematic, taking up to 1000 years to biodegrade; even then they still exist as micro plastics. We need the government to ban plastic bags in order to try and help the current climate change issue to which these plastic bags are contributing majorly to.

STOP to open windows and outside doors in winter in schools, children freezing, Children across the UK now sitting with open doors and windows in winter, wearing coats inside classrooms, in freezing cold temperatures due to excessive ventilation and poor guidance from government. This is not acceptable for our children to be so cold they feel numb, wear coats, hat, gloves.

Ban hospital from stopping both parents from being with their children., The government should make it impossible for paediatric and neonatal wards from denying both parents access to their children while they are in hospital. As it stands on most wards. Only one parent is allowed in at a time despite family circumstances.

Scrap all charges for NHS services in England, The UK is said to have free healthcare but in fact many people have to pay for prescription charges, dental costs, eyecare test and glasses, and wigs. Everyone should have free access to everything that is prescribed and served from the NHS.

Lower family court fees, I feel that the price of the family court fees is extortionate and should be lowered to an affordable amount to allow more fathers and mothers to help gain access to their children.

Delay the Multiplication Tables Check until it has been consulted on., The Multiplication Tables Check is due to become statutory for all children in year 4 this summer (2022).   This exam was created by one minister without meaningful consultation with the education community and, in its current form, is not fit for purpose.

Provide funding for universal access to Fracture Liaison Services (FLS), The Government should commit to equitable access to FLS for all. The APPG on Osteoporosis and Bone Health’s recent report highlights the scale of under-diagnosis, under-treatment and missed opportunities in the NHS and provides a blueprint for change, which the Government should implement.
Recognise pancreatitis as a disability., Help people with Pancreatitis and get the illness recognised.

Extend the Leasehold Reform Act to ground rent on existing residential leases, Prior to the Leasehold Reform Act, the freeholders could set ground rent at whatever amount they chose. New protections do not extend to existing property owners. Many current leaseholders have found they are unable to sell as mortgage firms and banks may not approve lending on such properties.

Launch a national public awareness campaign about knife crime, The campaign should be focused on youth crime and gangs, showing how the consequences of knife crime ruins lives, both of the victim, their family, friends and the perpetrator.

Remove parental legal rights off parents who have abused their children, To remove legal parental rights from parents who have abused their children! 
Parents who have abused their children in anyway should automatically have their legal parental rights removed

Nasal Spray, We need a nasal spray for Autistic kids and adults

There's loads of unvaccinated people out there wanting vaccines but are terrified of needles. 
My child has had 0 vaccines since primary school. Including HPV.

Require all GPs have a designated Mental Health Nurse, In 2019, 40% of GP appointments were related to Mental Health. The impact of the covid-19 pandemic has further highlighted the importance of mental health. Yet, many patients presenting with mental health issues are failed by their GP.

Continue free Covid tests for families with extremely vulnerable members, The Government should continue Covid tests for families with vulnerable members. Many have kept loved ones alive for over two years with very careful management and isolation. Taking away tests for these families will surely cost lives, jobs, without any way of knowing how to protect them.

Ease visa rules for the first-degree relatives of British nationals in Ukraine, First-degree relatives of British nationals (to incl. spouses and children of the first-degree relative) applying for a Standard Visitor visa must be exempted from application fees and processed in a priority order similarly to those who applied through U.K.’s family migration route.

Ban the use of stiles & gates that are not accessible for wheelchairs and prams., Ban the use of stiles and other specific types of gates that are not usable by those with wheelchairs & prams on public and permissive footways, to make these routes more accessible. 

Not all walks are viable regardless of gating but those that are must be useable by all as a basic human right.
To allow students who fail GCSE Maths & English to still have a student loan, To not pass the law that only gives student loans to those who have passed their GCSE English and Maths.

Add hidden disabilities to the national curriculum, With increased reports of mental health issues, it’s imperative that child are educated about hidden disabilities, such as ADHD, ASD, Crohn's disease and many more. Sadly many people do not know about hidden disabilities, or neurodiversity. This can have a huge impact on people's lives.

Do not send any UK military to Ukraine, and send aid only, We do not want the United Kigdom to send Army, Navy, or Air Force into the Ukraine to support them in the current crisis with Russia. This is to prevent an attack from Russia, which would be devastating for the United Kindom and its people.

Review the current plans from the Augar Review for Post-18 Education 2019., Scrap the increase of student debt repayment to forty years. 
Scrap the reduction of income level for debt repayment to £25K.
Scrap minimum GCSE and A-level grades to qualify for student loan. 
Reduce tuition fees to £7,250 as promised.
Reintroduce maintenance grants for disadvantaged students.

Ban russian products from all supermarkets in the UK., Russia has invaded Ukraine and is responsible for the death of Ukrainian militarary personnel and civilian population that include children. More over, Russian military is destroying property of Ukrainian citizens and infrastructure projects that are critical for peoples safety.

Do not implement proposed changes to student loans, We ask the Government not to go ahead with their current plans for changes to student loan terms and eligibility for students who will enter university in 2023. We believe these changes would be harmful and discriminative.

Temporarily remove VAT from all fuel 
Domestic and for transportation, Given the current situation simply remove VAT from all energy sources bills 
As a temporary measure to help everyone weather the current onslaught of price increases

Delay rebated fuel duty changes on Red Diesel until supply and pricing is stable, Delay rebated fuel duty changes until supply and pricing stabilises. The economic sanctions taken against Russia and the war in Ukraine are creating a perfect storm within the fuel supply market.

All Fuels have risen dramatically in recent weeks and is already putting financial strain on business

Give Driving Instructors, lorry drivers and key workers a discount on fuel., A discount for those who need the fuel to work. For example, a discount card which is presented at the pay point, with the vehicles registration number and/or company name, along with the drivers details. By doing this means the card can only be used by the owner of the working vehicle.

Make All Animal Hunting Illegal, A lot of animal hunting in England is illegal, but not all of it. Some bird hunting for game is legal and that needs to stop. Humans shouldn’t kill wild animals just to have fun or as a sport, or for food.
Reduce fuel VAT for people on Mobility allowance, Extend VAT relief to fuel for Mobility Allowance recipients probably on production of a blue badge.
Offer households £350 per month for six months to house the British homeless, The Government is happy to pay households £350 per month to house Ukrainian refugees rent-free for 6 months.

Require all new motor vehicles be limited to a maximum speed of 80mph, The Government should take action on this important aspect of road safety and limit the maximum speed that new vehicles - except for emergency vehicles - can reach on the road to 80mph.
Reduce MP remunerations by one half., Government should reduce the remuneration of Members of Parliament by one half and retrospectively from taking office after the last General Election.

Seek to end the oppression of the Uyghur people in China, We want the UK Government to negotiate with the Chinese government to secure the release of Uyghur people held in so-called “re-education” camps. The UK Government must also ban any companies operating in the UK who are found to have used or profited from forced labour of the Uyghur people

Increase foreign aid to Sri Lanka during its economic crisis, I want the Government to increase foreign aid to Sri Lanka and extend the deadlines for any loans due to help it survive one of its hugest economic crises. Students cannot take exams because there is no paper, and people cannot learn because there is no electricity. Lives are being lost.

Ban the sale of rabbit cages under 8 square feet, Under the Animal Welfare Act 2006, owners of rabbits must make sure they meet their needs, including providing a suitable environment and place to live. Yet pet shops sell numerous cages that we believe are not adequate. This encourages improper care & threatens the animals welfare.

Ban the sale of disposable vapes., A recent innovation in vape technology, the disposable vape is becoming increasingly popular & is already one of the most frequent items of litter. These single-use plastics are now routinely found lying in the street, concealed amongst vegetation, floating in watercourses & on coastal strandlines.

Justice for children incorrectly labelled "educationally subnormal" in 1960s/70s, In the 1960s and 70s, hundreds of black children were labelled as "educationally subnormal", and wrongly sent to schools for pupils who were deemed to have low intelligence. We want the Government to apologise to those affected, and create a scheme to financially compensate them.

Increase sentences for domestic violence offences, The Government should increase minimum and maximum sentences for men and woman who are commit domestic violence offences. Offenders should also be subject to strict bail conditions, ineligible for early release, and sentences for additional offences should be served consecutively, not concurrently.

Extend the Warm Home Discount to everyone with a disability, Hundreds of thousands of disabled people are not eligible to claim the "Warm Home Discount". Although only £140, in these times of 'rocketing' fuel prices it could make the choice between heating and eating harder! I want anyone with a disability to be able to claim this discount.

Legalise and incentivise uptake of personal electric vehicles, I would like the Government to legalise and create incentives to promote uptake of all personal, micro powered, more carbon efficient vehicles. This could help reduce carbon emissions from personal transport.

Revoke the right of registered sex offenders to change their name by deed poll, Make it illegal for registered sex offenders to change their name by deed poll. This loop hole has existed for far too long, and makes it easier for sex offenders, including those who have abused children, to avoid identification and conditions of their release.

Tougher laws against publishing animal cruelty images and/or videos, Cinematograph Films (Animals) Act 1937 needs to be updated or additional legislation put in place to require social media and hosting companies to remove animal cruelty content, which is published claiming to be educational or documentaries.
Require MPs who break the law be removed from office, Make it so that an MP found to have broken the law while in office must be removed, and a by-election held to replace them.

Stop deporting asylum seekers to Rwanda, The recent announcement of Priti Patel's plan to send asylum seekers that arrive in the UK to Rwanda is abhorrent and inhumane. We should not be sending extremely vulnerable people, at great cost to the taxpayer, to a country that the UK raised human rights concerns about just last year.
Keep MOT tests as a yearly requirement, We want the Government to maintain the yearly MOT tests for all classes of vehicle that currently require one.

Free NHS Prescriptions for 18 Year Olds and over in Full Time education, Free NHS Prescriptions and all other services, such as, dental care, sight tests, funding for vision instruments, wigs and fabric support must be given to those who are 18 years and over within Full Time education
Require family court cases with domestic abuse issues to be heard by a judge, You don’t need any formal qualifications to be a Magistrate.

Paid Overtime to be untaxed., Any pay associated with over the i.e 
full time  = anything over 37.5hrs 
Part time = anything over 16hrs

Require food & drink to be labelled with suitability for vegans and vegetarians, The Government should require manufacturers and retailers to label their packaged food and drink with a clear sign whether it is suitable or not suitable for vegetarians and vegans.

Start a public enquiry into the failings of Her Majesty’s Passport Office, The government should launch a full and public enquiry into the failings of Her Majesty’s Passport Office. The enquiry should look into full, the activity and the lack of processing of passport applications since April 2021.

Require the NHS have separate gynaecology units for women who are not pregnant, Most hospitals do not have separate gynaecology units, which means women who are having miscarriages or are infertile are having to be subjected to mixing with pregnant women. This can be emotionally and mentally draining and affect our mental health.

Introduce a tax relief for commuting to and from a single place of work, Introduce a full or partial tax relief for expenses incurred commuting to and from a place of work, whether that be by car or public transport.
This would be much more effective than the 5p per litre fuel duty cut as the saving is passed on directly to the consumer.

Require Cosmetic Surgery and Non Surgical Aesthetic ads to display a risk logo, The public are at risk when viewing ads for Non Surgical Aesthetic Procedures and Cosmetic Surgery. Increasing reports on complications and injuries mean that a risk logo would remind the public to research the procedure, related risks and complications about the treatment they may be considering

More help for carers: stop deducting carers allowance from Universal Credit, I want the government to stop deducting carers allowance from Universal Credit Claims. Universal credit allows people who are working or in self employment to earn a certain amount before deducting any UC. The government should stop automatically deducting carers allowance in the same way.

Include Carers Allowance in the £650 cost of living payment, The government to include people claiming Carers Allowance in the cost of living payment as it is not a means tested benefit they do not qualify

Relax visa rules for foreign workers for the hospitality sector. , Many businesses at risk and are facing shutting down because there is a massive lack of staff.
Hospitality is one of the main economy engines for the whole country and there should be more availability of staff before thousands of businesses fail.

Urge China to ban the Yulin dog meat festival , We want the British government to put pressure on the Chinese government to ban the Yulin dog meat festival due to take place in June. It is cruel and barbaric. It lets the whole of China down.

Negotiate with the EU to allow the use of UK issued pet passports as previously, Since the UK left the EU pet passports issued in England, Scotland and Wales are no longer valid for pet travel within the EU. There are many other countries that are not EU members but still benefit from being able to travel with their pets, using a passport issued in their own country.

Ban Fishing and Fish Farming, 200 million tons of fish are produced for food each year, both from the wild and from fish farms. Fish are sentient beings; they feel pain, like we mammals do. They are not vegetables. They have lives that matter. Also, overfishing is ruining the ecosystems and decimating fish populations.

Lower petrol prices to a reasonable rate everyone can afford., It is crazy to think at the start of the pandemic petrol was less that £1 now it’s almost reaching £2. We’ve already suffering with higher electricity and gas bills and now we’re expected to tolerate petrol going up to £2+ a litre. It’s ridiculous. This is benefiting no one apart from the government

Appoint government advisers and Anti-Hatred Working Groups for all faiths, The Government has previously appointed an independent adviser on Islamaphobia, and established an Anti-Muslim Hatred Working Group. We believe similar advisers and working groups should be established in respect of all faiths.
Inquiry into Debendox and birth defects, and fund compensation, Parliament debated this drug in 1984 as it was thought to have caused birth defects.

Introduce end-of-life payments for people who die before receiving state pension, If a person has paid National Insurance for years (eg. 20, 30, 40 years) and they die before receiving a state pension, the Government should make an end-of-life payment to the person's estate. This could help cover bills or funeral costs, or go to people in the deceased's will.

Raise the tax personal allowance reduction threshold from £100,000 to £150,000, Currently, the Personal Tax Allowance goes down by £1 for every £2 that your adjusted net income is above £100,000 and the allowance is zero if your income is £125,140 or above. With the cost of living crisis and historic high inflation, everyone is struggling and the threshold needs to be raised.
Fund free chicken pox vaccinations for all children, The Government should fund free chicken pox vaccination for all children.
Hold a Referendum on re-joining the EU, Brexit is the biggest disaster any government has ever negotiated.

Increase the personal allowance to £15,000 by 2023., I propose that the personal allowance is put up to £15,000 as the extra £70.00 in 2021 is useless for people when inflation is pushing 10% and national insurance rises aim to force the poor to fund the social care of older, wealthier homeowners.

Make it mandatory for Police & CPS to provide counselling to ALL victims of CSA, Make it mandatory the Police & Crown Prosecution Service provide ALL victims of child sexual abuse with counselling & support before during & after trial without prejudicing justice. This is in gov legislation, but the CPS & Police still advise victims it can affect the trial. This needs to end.
Include the Working Class in the £650 Cost of Living Payout, Working class who earn under a government agreed amount per annum to be included in the cost of living payout

Publish data on the deaths of health care staff from Covid 19 by ethnicity, The Government should publish data on the deaths of health staff from Covid-19 by ethnicity, as it is in the public interest to do so.

Remove the VAT for fuel during this difficult perioud, The fuel price is very high and the government need to do something about it.same as you did before with covid-19 issue and lately with the electricity issue
Remove indemnity from the manufacturers of covid-19 vaccines, Remove indemnity from the manufacturers of covid-19 vaccines, to allow individuals to pursue claims for compensation against them.

Require all public buildings to install gender-neutral bathrooms

 , There are many non-binary/questioning/demi-genders within the UK and they find it difficult to choose whether to use a male or female bathroom. We need gender neutral toilets and bathrooms with just cubicles and sinks so that those that do not identify as either male of female feel comfortable.

Remove the CQC’s license as an Independent Governing Body over Care Homes, etc., Go to The People’s Care Watchdog Support Group, read of all the cases where our Elderly are being abused neglected and violated. The CQC have been informed on numerous occasions, no support is forthcoming to families. In some cases Care Providers are being targeted while others are being favoured
Keep Boris as Prime Minister, Reinstate Boris Johnson as Prime Minister to uphold what the people voted for in 2019

Mandatory SEND training for all local authority education staff, The Government should require all local authority staff to undergo training in SEND, to give them a better understanding of how SEND children see the world and the daily struggles many have.

Let the people decide whether Boris Johnson should stay on as our Prime Minister, There has to be a change to how our democracy works. Like it or not, lots of people vote for party leaders, they vote for the PM and not their local MP. For a local MP to be able to go against the will of the people in order to further their own ambitions is twisted and disgraceful.

Ban public transport workers from going on strike, I would like the Government to ban all public transport workers from going on strike. The Unite union have just announced that Arriva bus drivers in the North West will be going on an all-out strike starting on 20th July.

Allow culling of black-backed gulls using a general licence, In 2020 black-backed gulls were removed from the list of birds that can be killed using a general licence, which allows an authorised person to kill or take certain animals to prevent serious damage to livestock, crops, vegetables, fruit, fisheries or inland waters. We want this decision reversed.

Legalise gender selection in specific circumstances, Legalise gender selection and have NHS funding for those who suffer mental health disorders after having 3 or more of the same sex children resulting in "gender disappointment" to equal out the male to femal ratio.

Make World Mental Health Day a national bank holiday, With World Mental Health Day awareness growing by day, and many employers recognising this at place off work, its time UK formally celebrates this with a national bank holiday.
Cancel HS2, The construction of HS2 is destroying green land and homes, and will benefit only a small proportion of people. We want the Government to cancel this scheme immediately.

Ban automatic disconnection of people on Pay As You Go Energy Meters, We need the government to ensure there is no Self Disconnecting of energy for the poorest in our society by guaranteeing, that even when they cannot top up the prepay energy meters they will still work. This could be done via a weekly amount put on to the meters or allowing meter to apply debt.

Allow people to vote "for" or "against" parliamentary e-petitions, There is no count of the opposing view in the existing e-petition system. This can be used to dismiss any petition outcome, because the level of opposition is unknown. Allowing people who oppose a petition to vote against it could give petitions more weight and attract more democratic interest.

Don’t borrow or use public money to prop up private energy companies’ profits, The government’s refusal to tax the massive profits made by private energy companies and instead to SUPPLY them taxpayers’ money is an outrageously irresponsible use of public finances.  This petition demands that the use of public money is fair, fully scrutinised and directly for the public good.

Lifetime driving ban if you are convicted of causing death by dangerous driving., I would like to change the law on "if you are  convicted for causing death by dangerous driving then a lifetime driving ban should be imposed", they should never be allowed to drive again.

Set up a panel to support reviews into attacks on or deaths of social workers, The Government should set up a panel which supports local authorities to review  cases where a social worker or safeguarding professional is attacked or killed while working. The panel could also conduct wider reviews to help improve local authority practices.

Allow all British Army soldiers to grow neatly trimmed facial hair, The Royal Navy are allowed to grow beards. British soldiers used to be allowed to grow beards however that has been banned and now they have to parade clean shaven. Growing a beard can increase moral, and we believe this change could contribute to operational effectiveness as a result.

Extend Paternity Leave to 4 weeks for first time parents., First time father's should be given 4 weeks Paternity Leave, an additional 2 weeks on top of standard current paternity leave. This will allow both parents the neccessary time needed to adjust to this major life changing event.
Remove the current Prime Minister and Chancellor of the Exchequer, Remove the current Prime Minister and Chancellor from power immediately, before more damage is done to the United Kingdom.

Stop unnecessary road works for cycle lane project in London Road in Buntingford, The residents of Buntingford have had enough of building and roadworks appearing in the town. There is due to be roadworks in Buntingford starting the week commencing 24.10.22 all the way until late August 2023. We do not want a one way cycle lane. Stop these roadworks.

Introduce mandatory minimum standards for inclusive product packaging, We want Government to work with Industry, Academia and the Design Sector to enforce minimum inclusive standards for product packaging, similar to Part M of the Building Regulations that govern the accessibility of buildings, to ensure packaging is consistent with the Equality Act.
Bring Back Boris Johnson For PM, We would like Boris Johnson to become the Prime Minister.

To call a general election in the event of a prime minister resigning., To change the law so that In the event a current serving prime minister resigns or is forced to step down from there position a general election is called regardless of which party is in power. This is so that the people can determine who is the best choice to lead the country.

New offence of stealing from a charity with a minimum 4-month sentence, I would like there to be a new, specific offence for anyone found guilty of stealing from a charity, including charity shops, with a mandatory custodial sentence of 4 months. In my opinion the Government is not doing enough and needs to crack down on stealing from charities.

A minimum of 2 years as PM before the Public Duty Cost Allowance is available., It is unfair that someone serving a few weeks as PM is entitled to an annual allowance of £115,000. There should be a minimum time spent serving in that capacity before the payments are triggered

Fund regular in-school dental health check-ups for children, I’d like for a dentist to visit schools yearly, to check pupils teeth, many visit schools now but just hand out a tooth brush and explain how to brush teeth, I’d like the dentist to actually check the pupils teeth so that a child is gaining access to free dental care
Ban fireworks that make a noise. Silent fireworks only by law., No one needs to terrify animals and kill wildlife to enjoy fireworks.  So all fireworks should be silent.
Ban the sale of fireworks to the general public., Only sell fireworks to public displays. The trauma these cause to domestic animals and wildlife is disgraceful

Fund increased policing against homophobic hate crimes, We want the Government to do more against homophobic hate crimes, by funding increased policing to tackle these crimes. It’s time we all stood together to help prevent people being attacked and abused just for being themselves.

Action Against Supermarkets to Donate 'Waste' Food To Food Banks and Charities., To bring forward the 2030 food waste pledge and make supermarkets responsible for all of their food waste, but making sure they dispose of it in a more humane way, thinking of those in need rather than exploiting their profits.
Fund increased pay for teachers who work with SEND children, We want higher pay for teachers who work with children who have special educational needs or a disability.

UK should recognise EASA drone classifications until its own come in to effect, Two years after leaving the EU the UK has yet to implement a replacement for the EASA drone classification scheme.

The CAA has announced a further 3-year extension to the transitional period. Without a classification scheme, UK drone owners are in an unreasonable and confusing legislative limbo.

Stop M.P's from using Tax payers money for their Christmas Parties., Stop any MP's from using tax payers money   to purchase refreshments and decorations during the festive period, as the costs of living is rising and people have to chose between heating and food.
Ban uniform in schools., To remove the need for uniform in schools and spark individuality.

Investigate Anti-Hindu propaganda & hatred attacks on Hindu Community, Create a Parliamentary committee to 

1) Form a cross-Government Anti-Hindu Hatred Working Group to discuss issues & concerns with Hindu stakeholders & Proposals for Policies.

2) Investigate if appropriate and timely actions were taken during recent attacks on the Hindu community in the UK.

Repeal & Replace PIDA1998 with an Office of the Whistleblower (OWB)., Adopt the Whistleblowing Bill proposed by the APPG for Whistleblowing  - To ensure every citizen is protected against retaliation when raising concerns, that concerns are properly investigated & those responsible held to account. 

www.appgwhistleblowing.co.uk

Give doctors and nurses the 20% pay rise they deserve, With current inflations and current problems in the current system; medical professionals deserve a pay rise.

Give them the 20% pay rise they need and deserve.
